

❯ /model fable
  ⎿  Set model to Fable 5.1 and saved as your default for new sessions

❯ /model sonnet
  ⎿  Set model to Sonnet 5.5 and saved as your default for new sessions

❯ /model haiku
  ⎿  Set model to Haiku 5.5 and saved as your default for new sessions

❯ /model bogus
  ⎿  Model 'bogus' not found

❯ /effort low
  ⎿  Set effort level to low (saved as your default for new sessions): Quick, straightforward implementation with minimal overhead

❯ /effort medium
  ⎿  Set effort level to medium (saved as your default for new sessions): Balanced approach with standard implementation and testing

❯ /effort high
  ⎿  Set effort level to high (saved as your default for new sessions): Comprehensive implementation with extensive testing and
     documentation

❯ /effort xhigh
  ⎿  Set effort level to xhigh (saved as your default for new sessions): Deeper reasoning than high, just below maximum (on supported
     models)

❯ /effort max
  ⎿  Set effort level to max (this session only): Maximum capability with deepest reasoning. May use excessive tokens resulting in long
     response times or overthinking. Use sparingly for the hardest tasks.

❯ /effort auto
  ⎿  Effort level set to auto


  ❯ /model                            Set the AI model for Claude Code (currently Haiku 5.5)
    /auto-mode-setup                  Teach auto mode about your environment, plus optional rule tweaks
    /code-review                      3 free /ultrareview · Review the current diff or a PR for bugs and cleanups
    /plugin-authoring                 Write a mod: a live pane, view or behaviour change in Claude Code
    /update-config                    Change settings: hooks, permissions, environment variables
